notes: §1985:II.4.2 SR3 (as amended by X3.23b-1993): "Every occurrence of an element in a table can be assigned the same initial value using the VALUE clause."; §1985:VI.5.15.6 GR6 gives the effect, "causes every occurrence of the associated data item to be assigned the specified value". An 85 VALUE clause is the data-item format only (the table format, VALUE ... FROM, is refused at 85 with COBOL0900), so DataItem.ValueAt answers the one literal for every subscript tuple; FieldInit builds a table's array from one uniform occurrence run (OccurrenceRunEmit.Array) whose element InitializerFor composes from that literal, and ImageInitOf repeats the same composition for a table stored as a character image (under a REDEFINES). Probed at --std 85: every occurrence took the value for DISPLAY, COMP, COMP-3, sign-separate, edited, JUSTIFIED and figurative-constant elements, a group-level VALUE on the OCCURS entry, three nested dimensions, an OCCURS DEPENDING table at its maximum, redefined records, and again on each entry of an INITIAL program and after CANCEL. The witness displays four tables: an elementary element, a group's two items, a two-dimension element and a group-level VALUE.

next.reason: Amendment X3.23b-1993 replaced 'The value of selected table elements may be specified using VALUE clauses' with 'Every occurrence of an element in a table can be assigned the same initial value using the VALUE clause' (§1985:II.4.2 SR3), the third and last of the ways 'initial values of elements within tables are specified'; it matches §1985:VI.5.15.6 GR6 ('causes every occurrence of the associated data item to be assigned the specified value'). 2023 keeps that effect for the data-item format (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR9 'causes every occurrence of the associated data item to be assigned the specified value') and adds the table format, which GR9 does not govern: 'The table element initialized is identified by subscript-1' (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR12), repeated 'until the table element identified by subscript-2 is initialized' (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR13; §2023:13.18.63.4 GR14 without TO), in an entry that 'shall contain an OCCURS clause or be subordinate' to one (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR18). The counterpart concept text now reads 'The value of selected table elements may be specified using VALUE clauses with or without the optional TO phrase' (§2023:D.3.3, informative). Words that differ: 1985 'Every occurrence ... the same initial value'; 2023 'selected table elements'. VALUE ... FROM (n) [TO (m)], giving occurrences different values and refused by 1985, is accepted: a case added.
